UXD is a stablecoin protocol on the Solana blockchain. UXD is designed to be delta-neutral, hedging its crypto collateral with short perpetual futures positions. UXD is collateralized by crypto assets such as SOL, BTC and ETH.

StakeDAO is a DeFi protocol on the Ethereum blockchain. StakeDAO acts as a yield optimizer for Curve Finance liquidity providers. StakeDAO is governed through its SDT token.

Marinade is a liquid staking protocol on the Solana blockchain. Marinade issues mSOL as a liquid staking token representing staked SOL. Marinade distributes delegated stake across multiple validators.

Stakewise is a liquid staking protocol on the Ethereum blockchain. Stakewise issues rETH2 as a liquid staking token for staked ETH. Stakewise pools ETH deposits from users to run validators.
